verdict.rationale: Viam is a cloud platform that collects and stores user machine data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documented policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The CLI's ability to delete data and the user's own ML training features are adjacent capabilities, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
